Membership & support / 会员与支持

JoyFlock is an independently operated browser game platform. Flight Party is our first multiplayer board game.

Free play / 免费游玩

Guests and registered users may play without a daily game limit. Only accounts signed in when a match starts are eligible for cumulative statistics. The first completed signed-in game each UTC day is recorded free, including negative points. Later games remain playable.

Optional membership / 可选会员

USD $9 per month or USD $59 per year. Membership records every completed, server-verified signed-in game while active. It does not affect dice, rules or winning chances. Applicable taxes, if any, are shown at checkout.

Subscriptions automatically renew at the selected interval until canceled. Sign in, open Account, and choose Cancel auto-renewal. Cancellation retains the already-paid period; it does not automatically refund earlier payments. Refund requests can be sent to support and are assessed under applicable consumer rights and Creem policies.

Payments are currently in sandbox testing, available only to designated test accounts. Public paid membership is not yet available. Sandbox membership does not grant a real paid entitlement.

Support / 客服

Email 13428961230@163.com for billing, cancellation, privacy, account deletion or game problems.

No wagers, cash prizes, cash-out, virtual currency, in-game items or third-party game accounts are sold.
